Verdict: **B**. Written to `/Users/nico/development/engineering.memento/lenny/.grid/worktrees/lenny/lenny-qxx.7/.grid/critique/test-coverage.json`.

Summary: the parser, Android press vocabulary, masked-flag derivation, and the `backendForPlatform` selection factory all get real tests with positive and negative controls (duplicate-resource-id fallback, unknown-platform `ArgumentError`, iOS-only keys throwing, both masked branches). Gaps: `resolve()`, `tap()`, `swipe()`, `connect()`/`close()`, and `watch()`/`snapshot()` have zero unit coverage in this diff (mirrors the pre-existing `AppiumBackend` test's own gap, so not a new regression, but still a real hole), and the new host-runner `ArgumentError → exit(64)` branch in `bin/leonard_native_host.dart` is untested by anything beyond a grep check on the source text.
